summary: Kurask require 70 Slayer and can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons, broad arrows or bolts, or Magic Dart; everything else (including cannons and thralls) deals no damage. They hit inaccurately with crush up to 11, so most players melee with a leaf-bladed battleaxe under Protect from Melee, or skip prayer and heal with Bones to Peaches. The Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (fairy ring AJR) has 5 kurask plus a 9-spawn task-only area; the Iorwerth Dungeon (Song of the Elves) has 14 tightly grouped kurask that also drop crystal shards. Bring an herb sack and alch runes since the task is profitable.
styleNotes: Leafy attribute: only leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition or Magic Dart can damage them; immune to cannon and thrall damage (immunecannon = yes, immunethrall = yes); weakest to stab, ranged and magic but the leaf-bladed battleaxe is best due to its max hit; king kurask superior hits up to 33.
requiredItems: Leaf-bladed sword, battleaxe or spear, or broad arrows/bolts, or Magic Dart
usefulItems: Herb sack (always three herbs per herb roll)
Nature runes for High Level Alchemy
Prayer potion in case the king kurask spawns
Ring of wealth to auto-pick coin drops

summary: A Krystilia-only Wilderness task at Lava Dragon Isle (level 36-42 Wilderness), a multicombat area with 8 dragons. They melee up to 23 and breathe dragonfire up to 50, so bring an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield plus antifire, and use Magic (they have 1 Magic level and a 50% water weakness) or Ranged from the many skeleton-pile safespots inside the isle or from the southern spawns outside it. The isle is above level 30 Wilderness, so no teleports work; 74 Agility unlocks the southern stepping-stone shortcut.

summary: A 48 Slayer task from Chaeldar or Konar after Perilous Moons, popular as AFK melee. All lesser nagua have -4 flat armour so every hit deals 4 extra damage, making fast or multi-hit weapons like the dual macuahuitl ideal. Sulphur nagua at Neypotzli are the default: supplies are free there (moonlight potions restore prayer and boost melee, bream and moss lizard are food), a cannon can be placed and there are safespots, though they drain 5 prayer if you stand in melee range during their wind-up. Frost nagua (Ruins of Tapoyauik, The Heart of Darkness) are magic attackers negated by Protect from Magic, and earthen nagua (Tonali Cavern, The Final Dawn) become weak to crush below 60% health.
styleNotes: -4 flat armour (multi-hit and fast weapons excel); sulphur nagua attack with slash and earthen nagua with stab (Protect from Melee), frost nagua use magic (Protect from Magic); earthen nagua shift to crush-weak armour below 60% health; spectral but not undead; poison resistance 0 (Amoxliatl 100).
usefulItems: Dual macuahuitl or other multi-hit weapon
Moonlight potions (made in Neypotzli)
Butterfly net (75 Hunter) to catch moonlight moths for 22 prayer points
alternatives: Amoxliatl (boss variant of frost nagua at the Ruins of Tapoyauik, better drops; cannon-immune, 100 poison resistance, -2 flat armour)

summary: An 85 combat task from Konar, Nieve or Duradel that needs Dragon Slayer I started. All metal dragons breathe long-range dragonfire that Protect from Magic does not reduce, so full protection needs an antifire potion plus an anti-dragon or dragonfire shield, or a super antifire; they are draconic (dragon hunter lance/crossbow) and weakest to stab and earth spells. The quickest task is bronze dragons in the Brimhaven Dungeon task-only area (5 in a small cannonable room), or iron dragons if you want a visage chance; rune dragons at Lithkren Vault (Dragon Slayer II) are the profitable choice. Only mithril dragons (Ancient Cavern) cannot be cannoned.
